reason: Both reviewers found prune conflating the two roots — it reads task state from the host, which by construction has no journal, and reports every task unknown while exiting 0. Fixing it needs prune.py. The second vendor additionally found that the host-inviolability test excludes .git while git status refreshes the host index, so the criterion tested the letter of ADR-0008 Decision 3 and not its spirit; both are now in scope.
